links.outcome: 90-day readmission prediction: algorithm versus three cardiologists on same patients
links.effect: PRED'IC AUC 0.81, sensitivity 81.8%, specificity 69.7%; cardiologists sensitivity 90.9%, specificity 35.8%. Algorithm flagged 35% high risk versus 67% by cardiologists.
links.quote: Cardiologists demonstrated higher sensitivity (90.9%) but lower specificity (35.8%).

links.outcome: Algorithm performance across age and sex subgroups (exploratory)
links.effect: Consistent algorithmic performance across sex and age categories, with slightly higher specificity among older men.
links.quote: Subgroup analyses showed consistent algorithmic performance across sex and age categories, with slightly higher specificity among older men.

screen.reason: Retrospective study comparing the diagnostic/predictive accuracy of an algorithm (PRED'IC) versus clinician judgment (cardiologists) on historical patient records, including subgroup fairness analyses.
